-- store/store.go --
package store

import "context"

//fabrik:config store
type Config struct {
	Kind string `yaml:"kind" default:"memory"`
}

//fabrik:hook setup
func Setup(_ context.Context, c Config) error { return nil }

type DB struct{}

//fabrik:provider
func Open(c Config) *DB { return &DB{} }
-- web/web.go --
package web

import (
	"net/http"

	"app/store"
)

type Handlers struct {
	DB  *store.DB
	Cfg store.Config
}

//fabrik:http GET /
func (h *Handlers) Index(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}
